title: Steel Construction Services in Pakistan | Steel Mind
description: Design, detailing, fabrication, cleaning, painting, erection and after sale service for steel buildings in Pakistan, from one team at Steel Mind.
h1: Steel Construction Services in Pakistan: From Design to After Sale Support
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. provides seven services in one chain: design, detailing, fabrication, cleaning, painting, erection and after sale service. You can buy the whole chain or any single step.
alt: Seven steel construction services from design to after sale support.

faq.q: Can I hire Steel Mind for erection only?
faq.a: Yes, after the engineer reviews the drawings and the site.
Design comes first. Detailing follows once you approve the design.

items.name: Detailing
items.text: The drawings the factory and the site use.

items.name: Fabrication
items.text: Cutting, welding and assembly in the factory.

items.name: Erection
items.text: Assembly of the structure on your site.

blocks.text: Each service passes its work to the next in a fixed order. Because one company runs all seven, nothing is lost between steps. See One-Step Solution.
Some clients bring their own drawings and need fabrication only. Others need erection of steel they bought elsewhere. Steel Mind accepts these jobs after reviewing the drawings.
